ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: skimmed from the take
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} skimmed from the take. Before anyone counted it, a good share of what the crew stole went into {PAWN_possessive} own pocket, and everyone else has been short ever since without knowing why.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: in on the mutiny
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} was in on the mutiny. When the crew turned, {PAWN_pronoun} sided with them, right up until it went wrong and {PAWN_pronoun} was thrown into the pods with the very people {PAWN_pronoun} had betrayed.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: {PAWN_nameDef} was in on the uprising that threw everyone out, and sided with the traitors right up until it went wrong and {PAWN_pronoun} was driven out with the very people {PAWN_pronoun} had betrayed.
